This supports our mission to get more people active and outside.Learn about Outside Online's affiliate link policy After a year of hiking, camping, running, and climbing, there’s a good chance everyone on your list is dealing with an adventure-related ailment: a stiff back, a beat-up foot, a gnarly sunburn, a killer headache. This season, help take the edge off by treating them to a practical-but-appreciated health and wellness gift. These 13 goodies will relieve body aches, sleep troubles, and sun-related annoyances—or at least protect your loved ones from suffering the same fate in 2027. Gone are the days of slathering greasy lotion on your arms and back. With UPF 50+, REI Co-op’s classic shade hoodie prevents sun damage on long backcountry days and summertime runs. Even with the head-to-hips coverage, the sweat-wicking polyester-spandex blend will keep you dry. Thumbholes and a hood drawstring ensure the stretchy hoodie stays put as you jog, climb, or cycle. Bonus: The women’s style has a vent on the back of the hood that doubles as a ponytail outlet. Pound the pavement, then treat your tender feet to plush recovery slides. OOFOS’ proprietary foam is designed to absorb 37 percent more shock than similar shoes on the market, and the footbed cradles your heel to further minimize impact. When foul smells and grime inevitably build up, toss the spongy slides in the washing machine and air-dry. One of our top-rated hot yoga mats, the Liforme mat has a grippy surface that’s unrivaled. “When I practice on this mat in a heated room, I don’t need a towel and rarely need to wipe my hands to make sure I don’t slip,” one of our testers reported. Extra credit for the alignment lines and larger-than-conventional dimensions. The silence created with noise-canceling headphones can feel unsettling. These analog silicone ear plugs reduce noise by 14 decibels—that’s the volume difference between running a vacuum and a dishwasher—so you still have the comfort of background noise as you work from a coffee shop or camp solo. The included carry case keeps the ear tips from becoming a home for the dust bunnies at the bottom of your tote bag. Upgrade your mobility routine with a body roller built to minimize spine discomfort. The high-density foam roller’s center groove allows your spine to relax while you perform thoracic extensions or massage the lats, traps, and rhomboids. After hitting the upper body, use the channel to target the IT band and Achilles tendon. Expect a particularly grippy surface thanks to the embossed diamond texture. Formulated with skin-care ingredients like hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, and aloe vera, this transparent stick sunscreen glides onto skin. Even tough-to-reach spots—like the sides of the nostrils and hair part—effortlessly get broad-spectrum SPF 45 protection thanks to the stick’s “teardrop” shape. Stash it in a fanny pack, hipbelt pocket, or glove compartment, and you’ll never have an excuse to not reapply. Reset your sleep routine with an alarm clock that doesn’t come furnished with TikTok. Power down at bedtime with Hatch’s dimmable reading lamp and calming background sounds like rain falling, a fan running, or wind blowing. Then, wake up to a “sunrise” and the gentle sounds of birds chirping, à la Snow White, or a good-morning call straight from Love Island. Traverse open ridgelines, kayak down rivers, and train for marathons on bright pavement while keeping your peepers safe. The Tera’s polarized lenses reduce glare (goodbye, headaches) and UV400 lenses block 100 percent of UVA and UVB rays. Plus, the removable magnetic shields wrap around the sides of the recycled frames, blocking rays, dust, and snow from reaching your eyes. Staying hydrated is always important. This Stanley tumbler makes doing so both easy and stylish, with its bold, Jeep-branded design and insulated stainless-steel construction that keeps liquids cold (or warm, if preferred) for hours on end. The 40-ounce mug is designed with an extra-large handle and a straw that make sipping simple on the move, while the tapered bottom fits into most cupholders. It’s also dishwasher safe, so the only real question to answer is what snacks you’ll be pairing its contents with. Ideal for the designated mom of the friend group, this whimsical mini first-aid kit packs the essentials needed for sudden cuts and scrapes: 18 flexible fabric bandages in two sizes, three antibiotic ointment packets, and three hand sanitizer packets. When empty, repurpose the pastel “tie-dyed” metal container for your patches, stickers, or tiny toiletries. Stop wasting money on overpriced teeny toothpaste tubes. These two refillable containers allow you to bring up to a three-week supply of your paste of choice—prescription, Sensodyne, you name it—in your carry-on. Reviewers say they’re perfect for moisturizers and Vaseline, too. Erase the lingering pain linked to your desk job or overpacked weekender. The extra-firm tip digs deep into cranky knots, and the two massage balls allow you to simultaneously work the muscles running along both sides of your spine. Thanks to the cane-shaped design, you’re able to hit every hard-to-reach spot on your backside without needing a masseuse. Stave off caffeine-withdrawal headaches while car camping or vacationing in an ill-equipped Airbnb. Combining the powers of pour-over, immersion, and air-pressure brewing methods, this travel coffee maker creates a smooth, rich, and full-bodied cup in just a few minutes. The entire system fits into its travel mug, making it carry-on-friendly to boot. Just remember to BYOB (bring your own beans). Combine a pair of booties with a sleeping bag, and the result is these mules from The North Face. The slippers boast a water-repellent upper stuffed with a synthetic down-like material, similar to your winter puffer. Fleece lining the interior keeps your toes cozy, and the rubber outsole makes the mules suitable for both taking out the trash and enjoying après-ski.
